thread:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported that a service account in workspace-A successfully decrypted a key belonging to workspace-B after last week's RBAC refactor. Support ticket: https://support.reddemo/INC-5421 :eyes:
ajay: Can you paste the audit log snippet and which patch landed?
maria: snippet from audit logs:
```
2026-03-18T12:34:56Z KMS decrypt request id=abcd1234 service_account=svc-web@workspace-A project=workspace-A key_name=projects/workspace-B/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key-1 outcome=ALLOW
```
olivia: That outcome should have been DENY. The new role inheritance rules might have expanded "workspace-admin" to include cross-project KMS roles.
security-bot: Alert: policy-change-break detected. Policy "project:inherit" was applied to role "workspace-admin" in prod at 2026-03-17T03:12:02Z.
kevin: I'm running a quick IAM scan to find any service accounts with kms decrypter roles on different projects.
ajay: Immediate mitigation: revoke any cross-project "roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter" bindings where principal.project != key.project. Doable now? :thumbsup:
maria: I've revoked two bindings for the impacted customer and flagged the support ticket.
olivia: Repro steps I used locally: 1) gcloud auth activate-service-account svc@workspace-A 2) call KMS decrypt on key in workspace-B 3) observe success when binding leak exists.
kevin: Query I'm running: `SELECT principal, role, binding_project, key_project FROM iam_bindings WHERE role='roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' AND binding_project != key_project;`
kevin: Query result: 4 rows. DMing the list to #incidents ops lead.
ajay: Hotfix idea: add a gateway-level rule in env-authz to reject KMS calls where request.kms_key.project != request.principal.project. Should be a fast guard.
maria: Can we also emit the evaluated policy decision (ALLOW/DENY + rule id) into the KMS audit entries? That would help triage.
security-bot: Created SEC-2026-1347: "cross-tenant KMS decrypt after RBAC refactor" — assigned @ajay, severity=P2.
olivia: I'll prepare a quick patch to RBAC evaluation that prefers explicit project-scoped bindings before inherited ones.
ajay: Timeline: push hotfix to deny at gateway within 2h, full patch with unit tests and regression suite in 48h.
kevin: Postmortem owner? I'll volunteer to help.
maria: I'll own the postmortem (timeline, root cause, remediation, list of affected customers and audit queries).
devops-bot: Deploy started: env-authz canary to us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T13:05:00Z.
maria: Thanks — please keep updates here. We'll need a communications draft for affected customers and a rollback plan if the canary shows false positives.
ajay: Adding mitigation checklist to ticket: revoke bindings, apply gateway deny, add audit enrichment, run full IAM scan, ship RBAC evaluation fix.
kevin: Also add KMS key admin notification and rotate any keys that had unexpected decrypts recorded.
maria: Noted. I'll update the ticket with rotation status once we confirm scope.
olivia: quick note: this change interacts with our caching layer for policy decisions. We'll ensure TTLs are cleared when we change policy semantics.
ajay: Good catch — I'll invalidate policy cache on rollout.
maria: OK closing loop for now. If anyone finds more cross-tenant decrypts, ping me directly.
